_: Variant B — LATE AFTERNOON. Same film, same five chunks, same geometry
sentences as kabina25-prompts-a.json; only the light and the grade differ.
That is the whole experiment: denoise 0.95 / vace_end 1.0 are held, and at
cfg 1.0 the prompt is the only conditioning there is, so the difference
between these two files IS the difference between the two deliverables.
A is the shot as a midday news crew would have got it: white sun outside,
cool open shade inside, everything legible and a bit unkind. B is the same
room two hours before sunset, with the sun low enough to come THROUGH the
louvred door rather than over it — which is the one lighting change the
control frames can actually carry, because the door is the only opening and
the bars of light it throws are already on the floor.
